svg.text: Block 160 long, 44 wide; top shaped to the wing lower skin at 490 out.

svg.text: Saddle on the bottom fits the 25 boom; the boom centre is 115 below the wing chord line.

svg.text: Two 5.5 holes on the centre line, 30 and 130 from the front, with M5 nut pockets.

svg.text: Four M4 heat-set inserts in the underside for the clamp caps, 17 either side of the centre line.

svg.text: Print standing on its side; bond to the wing hardpoint with thickened epoxy, then fit the bolts.
